```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(tidyr)
source("../R/helpers.R")

dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

data <- read_csv("../data/processed/anonymized_survey_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Objective

Validate the privacy-safe analytical dataset before any inference or modeling.

```{r dimensions}
dim(data)
glimpse(data)

quality_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("rows", "columns", "duplicate_rows", "duplicate_respondent_ids"),
  value = c(
    nrow(data),
    ncol(data),
    sum(duplicated(data)),
    sum(duplicated(data$respondent_id))
  )
)

write_csv(quality_summary, "../results/data_quality_summary.csv")
quality_summary
```

## Missing values

```{r missingness}
missing_summary <- data %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_n") %>%
  mutate(missing_percent = missing_n / nrow(data)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_n))

write_csv(missing_summary, "../results/missing_value_summary.csv")
missing_summary
```

## Duplicate rows

```{r duplicates}
sum(duplicated(data))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(data$respondent_id))
```

## Type checks

```{r types}
likert_cols <- c(
  "comfort_importance", "cost_importance", "availability_importance",
  "health_risk_importance", "leakage_protection_importance",
  "durability_importance", "reusability_importance", "variants_importance",
  "brand_importance", "quality_importance", "sustainability_importance",
  "affordability_importance", "satisfaction", "cultural_influence"
)

summary(data[likert_cols])

stopifnot(all(data$awareness_score >= 0 & data$awareness_score <= 1, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Factor preparation

```{r factors}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    awareness_category = factor(awareness_category, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"), ordered = TRUE),
    future_switch_intention = factor(future_switch_intention, levels = c("No", "Maybe", "Yes"), ordered = TRUE),
    changed_product_5y = factor(changed_product_5y, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    region_type = clean_factor(region_type),
    occupation = clean_factor(occupation),
    education = clean_factor(education),
    income_band = clean_factor(income_band)
  )

summary(data)
```

## Notes

The raw questionnaire is deliberately excluded from the public repository. This file is the analysis-ready dataset used throughout the remaining notebooks.
